passiveBonuses.desc: All Mongol buildings (except Stone Walls and the Ovoo) can be packed up and moved to a new location. Packed buildings travel at 50% standard unit speed, allowing the Mongol player to shift their entire base during a game
When Mongol military units destroy an enemy building, they gain 50% of the building's original resource cost back as gold. This rewards aggressive raiding and building destruction
All Mongol cavalry and ranged cavalry units move 10% faster than equivalent units for other civilizations. Their scout units also have 50% extended vision range
Mongol units do not lose movement speed when moving through forests or rough terrain. Cavalry units passing through enemy Influence zones do not trigger alert effects

age2.bonus: Sacred stone monument placed on stone deposits. Allows all military production buildings within its influence radius to produce units in pairs for +50% additional cost. Also generates 0.5 gold per second passively
Mobile command tent that acts as a secondary Town Center. Can be packed and moved. When unpacked near a resource deposit, villagers gathering from that deposit gain +25% gather speed

age3.bonus: Periodically spawns free Khan units (every 5 minutes). Each Khan provides a command aura boosting nearby cavalry attack by 15% and speed by 10%. Multiple Khans can be active simultaneously
Stone keep variant that can be packed and moved like other Mongol buildings. Generates 2 gold per second and can train Mangudai directly. Counts as a Stable for technology research purposes

age4.bonus: When activated (60-second cooldown), triggers a Great Khan's Call that instantly heals all Mongol units on the map for 30% of their max HP and grants them +20% attack speed for 30 seconds. Represents the great Mongol assembly
Periodically sends a free army of mixed units (2 Mangudai, 2 Keshik, 1 Traction Trebuchet) every 4 minutes from the building's location. Units arrive pre-upgraded to current Age tier

uniqueUnits.special: Elite mounted archer that can fire while moving at full speed with no accuracy penalty. Deals bonus damage to siege equipment. Kite ability: automatically retreats while firing when attacked by melee units

Free hero unit available from Age 1. Provides three command signals via unique abilities: Attack Move Signal (+20% attack speed to nearby cavalry), Flaming Arrows Signal (ranged units deal fire AoE for 10s), Sentry Signal (reveals a large area of fog of war). Respawns after 120 seconds if killed

Elite Mongol heavy cavalry that generates food on each kill. Bonus food amount: 10 food per infantry kill, 20 food per cavalry kill. Acts as a self-sustaining raiding unit for long campaigns away from base

Man-powered trebuchet available two ages earlier than standard trebuchets. Lower damage and range than the counterweight trebuchet, but available very early for siege aggression. Does not need to pack/unpack — fires from a mobile carriage

Massive counterweight trebuchet with an extended range of 10 tiles. Fires massive stones that deal splash damage in a 2-tile radius. Requires 60 seconds to set up (unpack) before firing. The ultimate Mongol siege weapon

uniqueTech.effect: All Mongol mounted archers and ranged cavalry now fire whistling arrows that apply a fear debuff to enemy units hit — causing them to temporarily slow by 20% and reducing their attack speed by 10% for 5 seconds
All Mongol cavalry units gain an additional +5% movement speed and can now move at full speed on all terrain types including mud, shallow water, and hillsides
Establishes the Yam postal road network — all Mongol units moving between owned buildings or Ovoo influence zones move 25% faster. Reinforcements arrive from Town Center 40% faster
Pillage bonus increases from 50% to 75% resource return on destroyed buildings. Cavalry units also gain +10% attack when within 5 tiles of an enemy building
Each active Ovoo now generates 1 gold per second in addition to its existing bonuses. Mongol religious sites (if relics are captured) generate double the standard gold income
